Jonas / team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the technical deep dive clarified a lot. Leadership here asked for a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation milestones to executive brief (EB) dates so we can unlock budget in mid-November.

Two asks from our side to help cadence this:
- Can you propose an EB meeting window (60–90 minute) in late Oct / early Nov where our exec sponsors (CIO + Head of Data) can see a targeted runbook?
- Can you map which Redwood exec/leader would be the sponsor for each MAP milestone (security sign-off, pilot data ingest, perf validation)?

I attached a starter MAP spreadsheet (Pioneer_MAP_v1.xlsx) with dates we think are realistic. Please mark who from Redwood would be the presenter and who is owning each deliverable.

Proposed EB windows (Pioneer availability):
- Oct 26–28, mornings PT
- Nov 3–4, afternoons PT

Looping Amit (pilot owner) for availability.

Thanks,
Lydia

- Oct 27, 09:00–10:15 PT (preferred)
- Nov 03, 13:00–14:15 PT

- Jonas: I’ll circulate ExecSponsor_Roles.pdf and a short 1‑pager agenda for the EB.
